nodes.label: LoopGuard Control API
nodes.rationale: Hosted control plane built health/error-contract boundary first, with database, auth, relay, streaming, action, artifact, workflow, and client endpoints landing in later tasks; production settings deliberately have no usable secret defaults — KMS/signing, PostgreSQL, OIDC, storage, Temporal, browser origins, and trusted proxies must all be configured explicitly.

nodes.label: Redacted Event Ingestion
nodes.rationale: The control plane accepts only authenticated, redacted local events and exposes tenant-scoped monitoring and control APIs — redaction happens before events ever leave the local machine.
